title: alertrulequality and alertenrichment are scaffolded but not wired into the server
answers: Is alertrulequality/alertenrichment actually running in the server?
Where is the app.go for alertrulequality?
Why can't I find a register.go for alertenrichment?
body: apps/alerting/alertrulequality/ and apps/alerting/alertenrichment/ only contain generated API type packages (pkg/apis/.../types.go, zz_generated.*) — there is no pkg/app for either, and no corresponding pkg/registry/apps/alerting/{alertrulequality,alertenrichment}/register.go. They are not referenced from pkg/registry/apps/apps.go, so these kinds don't run in the live apiserver yet.
